raw_segments.text: Aego, if I can fasten but one cup upon him, with that which he hath drunk to-night already,
he'll be as full of quarrel and offense as my young mistress, Dog.
Now my sick fool, Rhodrigo, whom love hath turned almost the wrong side out, to distimona
hath to-night caroused potations poddle deep, and he's to watch, three lads of Cyprus noble
swelling spirits that hold their honours in a wary distance, the very elements of this
warlike isle, have I to-night flustered with flowing cups, and they watch too.
Now, monced this flock of drunkards, am I to put our Casio in some action that may offend
If consequence do but approve my dream, my boat sails freely, both with wind and stream.
